tracks.title: 火借我一下 Hué Tsioh Guá Tsi̍t-ē
tracks.subject: a young man doing his first 7th-month ghost-festival offering alone outside his rented ground-floor room, table set with instant noodles, beer and crisps, who realises he has no lighter and walks to the convenience store in slippers to borrow fire for three joss sticks
